description: Six two-input logic gates in 4HP, chained so that each section reads the one above it unless you patch its first input

params.text: Chooses that section's operation: AND, OR or XOR
Inverts that section's result while it is red, making AND into NAND, OR into NOR and XOR into XNOR

inputs.text: The first signal that section compares; with the jack empty it reads the output of the section above, and 0V in the first section
The second signal that section compares, counted as high at 1V or more; an empty jack is read as low

outputs.text: Carries 10V while that section's comparison is true and 0V while it is false

notes: the chaining runs top to bottom, so a signal in the first input of section 1 can be carried through six operations in turn without a cable
feeding a gate into the first input of a section, leaving the second empty, choosing OR and inverting that input on the menu gives a plain NOT of the gate
menu: Section 1, Section 2, Section 3, Section 4, Section 5, Section 6 — each holds Input 1-1 and Input 1-2, Normal or Inverted, inverting that input before the comparison
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high detect-level — sets the voltage at which an incoming gate counts as high, 1V or more unless you change it
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
